# 非对角微扰项（锁定随机种子保证可重现） np.random.seed(42) V = np.random.randn(N_TOTAL, N_TOTAL) + 1j * np.random.randn(N_TOTAL, N_TOTAL)

# 对角正则化抽吸算子 kappa = np.zeros(N_TOTAL, dtype=complex) kappa[:N_SPACE] = 0.0 kappa[N_SPACE:] = 1.0 / R_ROOT**2

return M
# 测试 M_test = build_M(0.1) print('M 的 shape:', M_test.shape) print('M 的迹:', np.trace(M_test)) ```

M_eff = M_SS - M_SV * (L_G,VV + I_8)^{-1} * M_VS ''' M = build_M(epsilon)

kappa_reg = (1.0 / R_ROOT**2) * np.eye(N_VACUUM)
try: inv_term = np.linalg.inv(L_G_VV + kappa_reg) M_eff = M_SS - M_SV @ inv_term @ M_VS
